territorial_scope.description: Applies to the Chilean state agency (ANCI) and to institutions in Chile that are qualified as operators of vital importance.

evidence.quote: El presente reglamento tiene por objeto regular el procedimiento de calificación de los operadores de importancia vital de la ley N° 21.663, marco de Ciberseguridad.

summary.short: Sets the procedure for the ANCI to qualify essential-service providers and other institutions as operators of vital importance under Law 21.663 on cybersecurity: criteria, sectoral reports, preliminary and final lists, public consultation and appeals. Issued by decree dated 6 September 2024.
summary.long: Decree No. 285 (6 September 2024) approves the regulation on the procedure for qualifying operators of vital importance (OIV) under Law 21.663, the Cybersecurity Framework. The ANCI may qualify essential-service providers that depend on computer networks and whose affectation would have a significant impact, assessed by criteria on potential affected persons, redundancy, monoprovision, dependency and institutional relevance. It may also qualify private institutions that have acquired a critical role or are highly exposed to cybersecurity risk. Sectoral bodies must issue reports within 30 days. The ANCI prepares a preliminary list, approved by resolution and published, which is subject to a public consultation of at least 30 days, with notification to listed institutions and an executive summary of the consultation. The final list of private institutions, showing name, RUT and legal domicile, is approved by reasoned resolution and published; appeals under the administrative procedure law and a judicial claim under Law 21.663 Art. 46 are available. Public institutions follow a separate title with a Ministry of Finance report. Qualifications are reviewed at least every three years. Transitional provisions set a 90-day deadline for the first qualification and allow electronic notification under phased rules, otherwise registered mail.

relations.note: Enabling act. The regulation implements the procedure for qualifying operators of vital importance under arts. 5 and 6 of the law, as stated in Considerando 4.

notes: Only relations, entities and notes were annotated; other sections are not coded here. Considerando 1 gives the publication date of Ley 21.663 (8 April 2024); its entry into force is not stated in this text. Possible inconsistency: Artículo primero refers to a decreto con fuerza de ley N° 1-21.663, de 2024, of the Ministerio del Interior y Seguridad Pública, which this text does not otherwise identify; the DFL N° 1 of 2020 cited in the preamble is a different instrument. Considerando 4 names the ministry responsible for public security as the issuer, while the signature block shows the Ministro del Interior y Seguridad Pública (S). Preamble citations of Decreto supremo N° 164 de 2023 (Política Nacional de Ciberseguridad) and Resolución N° 7 de 2019 (Contraloría) are not coded as relations. Target_instrument_id is empty where the target is not in the registry, which was not provided. The document contains the heading Articulo 19° without accent; this does not affect the citations.

Dependencia: relación entre dos operadores en la que uno de ellos no puede proveer su servicio si no recibe un bien o servicio del otro.
Monoprovisión: característica de un servicio esencial en la que existe un único proveedor.
Redundancia: condición en la que una persona natural o jurídica puede reemplazar de manera inmediata la provisión de un servicio esencial, en caso de que este sea afectado o interrumpido.

obligations.summary: The Agency shall observe the guiding principles of Article 3 of the Law in conducting the qualification procedure.

evidence.quote: El procedimiento dispuesto en el presente reglamento deberá instruirse bajo los principios orientadores establecidos en el artículo 3° de la ley.

obligations.summary: The Agency may qualify essential service providers as vital importance operators where they meet the requirements: dependence on computer networks and systems, and significant impact of affectation, interruption or destruction of their services.
obligations.conditional_on: Requirements listed in Art. 4 numerals 1 and 2

evidence.quote: La Agencia podrá calificar a los prestadores de servicios esenciales como operadores de importancia vital cuando estos reúnan los siguientes requisitos

obligations.summary: For determining significant impact, the Agency shall consider one or more criteria: number of potential affected persons, service redundancy, monoprovision, service dependence, and relevance of the institution.

evidence.quote: la Agencia deberá considerar uno o más de los siguientes criterios

obligations.summary: The Agency may qualify private institutions that are not essential service providers as vital importance operators, where they meet the requirements of Art. 5 of the Law and their qualification is indispensable for a critical role or for exposure to cybersecurity risks.
obligations.conditional_on: Indispensability of qualification due to a critical role or degree of exposure to risks

evidence.quote: La Agencia podrá calificar como operadores de importancia vital a instituciones privadas

obligations.summary: The Agency shall review and update, where appropriate, the qualification of vital importance operators at least every three years, starting the next process at least 180 days before the three-year period expires; it shall publicise the start of the qualification process on its website.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá revisar y actualizar, si fuere pertinente, la calificación de operadores de importancia vital al menos cada tres años.

obligations.summary: For the sectoral public bodies' reports, the Agency shall request a reasoned report from sectoral public bodies with specific regulatory or supervisory powers, referring to the criteria of Art. 4 a) to e); it shall request a report from the Ministry of Economy, Development and Tourism where the institution is a smaller enterprise; these reports shall be evaluated under Art. 37 bis of Law 19.880.
obligations.conditional_on: Reports requested for the qualification study only; smaller-enterprise report where the institution is classified as such

evidence.quote: la Agencia deberá requerir informe fundado de los organismos públicos con competencia sectorial

obligations.summary: Sectoral public bodies shall deliver their requested report within 30 calendar days from receiving the request, individually for each institution in their competence, indicating whether the service depends on computer networks and systems and whether its affectation could have a significant impact.

evidence.quote: Los organismos públicos cuyo informe se solicite deberán evacuarlo dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos

obligations.summary: The Agency may request voluntary information from private institutions to prepare the preliminary list, setting a period of not less than ten calendar days.

evidence.quote: La Agencia podrá solicitar a las instituciones privadas antecedentes voluntarios para elaborar la nómina preliminar

obligations.summary: The Agency shall prepare the preliminary list of vital importance operators within 30 calendar days after the period in Art. 8 expires; the list shall be approved by resolution of the Director and published in the Diario Oficial or a national newspaper.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá elaborar la nómina preliminar de operadores de importancia vital dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos

obligations.summary: The preliminary list concerning private institutions shall be subjected to public consultation governed by principles of maximum disclosure, equal treatment, impartiality, transparency and effectiveness.

evidence.quote: la nómina preliminar respecto de las instituciones privadas deberá ser sometida a consulta pública

obligations.summary: The consultation shall be opened by resolution of the Director, which shall provide a period of dissemination and promotion of not less than ten calendar days from publication of the preliminary list resolution.

evidence.quote: la cual dispondrá un periodo de difusión y promoción que no podrá ser inferior a diez días corridos

obligations.summary: Institutions in the preliminary list shall be notified under Decreto Supremo 4 of 2020 during the ten-day period, and the notification shall state the right to submit observations and attach documents.

evidence.quote: las instituciones incluidas en la nómina preliminar deberán ser notificadas conforme lo dispuesto en el decreto supremo N° 4, de 2020

obligations.summary: The Agency shall provide an electronic platform allowing participation in the public consultation.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá poner a disposición una plataforma electrónica que permita la participación en la consulta pública.

obligations.summary: Observations on the preliminary list must be in writing with their grounds; for natural persons they must state name, identity card number and address or email; for legal persons they must be made by a legal representative with a certificate of validity issued within 90 days; they are due within 30 calendar days from publication of the Art. 10 resolution.

evidence.quote: serán admisibles aquellas observaciones en que esté debidamente señalado el nombre, cédula de identidad y domicilio o correo electrónico

obligations.summary: The Agency shall pronounce on citizen observations directly related to the qualification process.

evidence.quote: La Agencia deberá pronunciarse sobre las observaciones ciudadanas que se relacionen directamente con el proceso de calificación respectivo.

obligations.summary: The Agency shall make the executive summary and content of the public consultation available to the public on its website within 30 calendar days after the observation period expires.

evidence.quote: La Agencia pondrá a disposición del público el resumen ejecutivo y el contenido de la Consulta Pública en el sitio web institucional treinta días corridos después del vencimiento del plazo

obligations.summary: The Agency shall prepare the final list of private institutions qualified as vital importance operators within 30 calendar days from publication of the executive summary; the list shall state name, tax identification number (RUT) and legal domicile, and be approved by reasoned resolution and published in the Diario Oficial or a national newspaper.

evidence.quote: La Agencia elaborará la nómina final de instituciones privadas calificadas como operadores de importancia vital.

evidence.quote: La Agencia realizará el estudio de calificación de las instituciones públicas en el plazo dispuesto en el artículo 6°

obligations.summary: The Agency shall prepare a preliminary list of public institutions and request technical reports under Art. 7, and shall request a report from the Ministry of Finance.

enforcement.note: This procedural regulation sets the qualification procedure for operadores de importancia vital and contains no fines, penalties, revocations, suspensions or blocking. It refers to the parent law's Art. 46 only for a judicial claim against the qualification resolution (Art. 17), which is a remedy rather than a sanction. Sanction provisions, if any, sit in Ley 21.663, which is not part of this text.
